name: Mother Crocodile
description: A huge crocodile in the pit at the center of Kheru Temple to which Sidisi feeds her enemies.

timeline.summary: Sidisi sits crownless, obsessed with revenge on a goblin who took her crown, having fed her warning advisors to the Mother Crocodile.
timeline.quote: One by one, her most trusted advisors had warned her against the course of blind revenge
